traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune, Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Imagination meets power. A deep generational signature: intensified collective imagination and transformation. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Heightened collective vision. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize imagination and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what imagination and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Generational and collective; minimal personal day-to-day meaning.
shadow: The ease lets illusion and escapism and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

When Neptune sextiles Pluto, empathy and intuition support deeper investigation without requiring cynicism. Learning who benefits, what shaped the situation, and where influence sits can clarify what deserves loyalty, money, or trust. Care becomes more useful when it is attached to the thing actually happening rather than the story that was easiest to sell.
